label: portable-backup-table-coverage-v1
comment: Schema-aware inventory of PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE objects in db/supabase/migrations. Public-schema keys remain unqualified for contract compatibility; non-public schemas are qualified. This registry covers server migration tables only, not SQLite tables or individual fields, and is not a full database disaster-recovery manifest. Portable export and restore services have separate device, integration and recovery acceptance gates; excluded user-linked rows remain explicit coverage gaps.

admin_role_permissions.reason: Private administrative permission policy is operational security state preserved by full PostgreSQL recovery; customer portable restores cannot grant or replace administrator permissions.

maintenance.jobs.reason: Bounded job controls, leases and cursor/heartbeat state migrate with paired PostgreSQL backups; per-account portable restore cannot replace operational jobs.

maintenance.notifications.reason: Count-only internal maintenance failure notices and acknowledgement generations are operational records preserved by complete PostgreSQL recovery.

account_recovery.control.reason: Explicit operator account-recovery gate; paired PostgreSQL recovery preserves it.

account_recovery.snapshots.reason: Account recovery ciphertext and escrow keys use separate recent-proof/consent routes; ordinary portable archives never export recovery credentials. Complete paired PostgreSQL dumps preserve the ciphertext and wrapping-key metadata.

account_lifecycle.control.reason: Explicit operator worker enablement gate; complete paired PostgreSQL backups preserve it.

account_lifecycle.requests.reason: Deletion workflow history must not be imported by account portable restore; paired recovery and external tombstone reconciliation preserve account denial.

account_lifecycle.tombstones.reason: Authoritative deletion tombstones must survive full recovery and cannot be replaced by a per-account archive.

backup_status.attestations.reason: Sanitized paired-backup verification history is operational state, not per-account portable data; paired PostgreSQL recovery includes this schema.

imap_worker.poll_state.reason: A bounded worker polling cursor is operational scheduling state; account-scoped portable archives do not restore it. Paired PostgreSQL recovery includes it.

account_recovery.automatic_devices.reason: Per-device automatic recovery consent is managed through explicit recovery routes and never grants recovery-key retrieval. Complete paired PostgreSQL dumps preserve consent and opaque device bindings.

feedback_admission.buckets.reason: Opaque keyed route admission counters are operational abuse state, not portable account data. Full PostgreSQL backups preserve them; account import must not reset shared quotas.

feedback_admission.capacity.reason: Exact global abuse-store allocation counter migrates with the full PostgreSQL schema and buckets, never independently in an account import.

notification_delivery.profile_queue_coun.reason: Exact notification queue counters migrate with their private delivery rows in full PostgreSQL recovery; portable account import must not reset delivery state.

notification_delivery.global_queue_count.reason: Global pending/retained notification storage counters must travel with the complete PostgreSQL queue, not a per-account archive.

notification_delivery.revisions.reason: Private accepted notification intent and immutable payload revisions are preserved by full PostgreSQL backups. Account portable restore must not replay prior external sends; per-account portable notification history remains an explicit coverage gap. Full disaster recovery requires delivery replay/provider deduplication review before worker restart.

notification_delivery.outbox.reason: Private accepted notification intent and immutable payload revisions are preserved by full PostgreSQL backups. Account portable restore must not replay prior external sends; per-account portable notification history remains an explicit coverage gap. Full disaster recovery requires delivery replay/provider deduplication review before worker restart.

notification_delivery.worker_status.reason: Bounded worker heartbeat and aggregate delivery counters migrate in full PostgreSQL recovery. They contain no customer identifiers/payload and are not account portable-export data. Recovered heartbeats are stale until a real worker reports again.

sms_learning_settings.reason: Global SMS learning rollout controls are operational state; account-scoped portable restore must not replace them. Complete PostgreSQL recovery preserves them.

sms_category_rule_approvals.reason: Admin-reviewed shared category approvals govern all accounts and cannot be restored from a single account archive; complete PostgreSQL recovery preserves the review records.

sms_category_rule_v2_approvals.reason: Shared context-specific category approvals and admin attribution are platform review state, preserved by complete PostgreSQL recovery rather than per-account restore.

sms_parser_candidate_approvals.reason: Admin parser-candidate approval gates are global operational state and remain outside account-scoped portable restore; complete PostgreSQL recovery preserves them.

sms_ai_learning_proposals.reason: Account-linked opt-in AI learning proposals are not exported in portable v1. Their consent, moderation and cross-user eligibility cannot be replayed by a personal archive; complete paired PostgreSQL backups preserve this explicit coverage gap.

sms_learning_feedback_events.reason: Account-linked opt-in correction evidence and its source hashes are not exported in portable v1. Shared-learning consent and moderation require their own lifecycle; complete paired PostgreSQL recovery preserves these rows.
